## The Future of Water Management is Programmatic

### Autonomous Live Models

We engineer systems that are **self-updating** and **self-correcting**. By integrating automatic data acquisition with real-time visualization, we provide a "living" representation of your assets and environments.

### Our Core Domains

::: panel-tabset
## Subsurface

Advanced groundwater modeling and automation. We move beyond standard workflows to create agentic systems that oversee model calibration and sensitivity.

## Infrastructure

Intelligent pipeflow and network analysis. Utilizing tools like EPANET within automated pipelines to ensure your infrastructure data is never stale.

## Web Modelling Platform Development

### Platform for Integration of Models with Data

We build cloud-native platforms that transform static simulations into dynamic software assets. By linking numerical engines with real-time field observations, we ensure models adapt continuously.

```{=html}
<div class="row align-items-center platform-showcase g-5">
```
